text: Visible task `OG-WORKER-001` is marked `done` and records the Codex worker adapter capability as non-interactive distill, replay, and explain with schema-validated outputs. Its listed steps are to run Codex in `analyze`/`propose`/`apply` profiles, normalize `DistillDelta`, `ReplayPlan`, and `ClaimSet` payloads, and fail fast on malformed structured output; it depends on `OG-ADAPTER-001` and maps to `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `SPEC-v2.md`, `og`, and `to-do.json`.
